# @lyndon/ui

> Animated React 19 components in the shadcn style: Tailwind CSS (v4 or v3) for styling, motion for animation, themes as
> CSS variables (seven palette families, light and dark). Forms, overlays, navigation, data grid, charts, diagrams, maps,
> media, AI chat and agent UIs. Every component is also a self-contained .tsx drop-in file.

Version 0.11.0. Source: https://github.com/lantos1618/oneshot-ui. Docs: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/. Licence: MIT with a revenue threshold (free up to USD 200k ARR).

## Use it

- Install: `npm i @lyndon/ui motion` (peer deps react@19, react-dom@19). Core components come from `@lyndon/ui`; extras from their own subpath (`@lyndon/ui/charts`, `@lyndon/ui/kanban`, …), named in each group below.
- Styles: Tailwind v4 `@source "../node_modules/@lyndon/ui/dist";`, or without Tailwind `import '@lyndon/ui/styles.css'`.
- Wrap the app once in `<UIProvider>`: it injects the theme tokens, applies the theme (light/dark/system), hosts toasts.
- Colours only through tokens: `bg-[var(--card)]`, `text-[var(--fg2)]`, `border-[var(--line)]`, `var(--accent)`, `var(--ok|warn|bad)`. Override a component's class with Tailwind's `!` prefix.
- Strict CSP: `<UIProvider injectStyles={false}>` plus `import '@lyndon/ui/tokens.css'`, or pass `nonce`.

## Drop-in files (for AI chats and copy-paste)

Each file below is one component (or a small family) with exactly the helpers it needs, importing only react, react-dom
and motion. Attach the ones you need plus ui-provider.tsx; they share one UIProvider. Sizes are approximate tokens.

- CLI (offline, from the installed package): `npx @lyndon/ui add data-grid dialog --dir src/components/ui`, `npx @lyndon/ui list`, `npx @lyndon/ui info data-grid`
- shadcn CLI: `npx shadcn add https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/r/data-grid.json` (pulls in ui-provider)
- Index with sizes, exports and embedded components: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/index.json
- The same files from npm: https://unpkg.com/@lyndon/ui@0.11.0/dist-registry/files/<name>.tsx
- Whole library in one file (dist-single/ui-all.tsx, ~636.8k tokens): only for tools with a very large context; prefer the drop-ins

## Tags

Items are grouped below: core by area, then extras by family, then blocks; each line gives the item's kind and tags (ids from one vocabulary: labels,
descriptions and synonyms are in index.json under `vocabulary`; the showcase filters by them with `?tags=id,id`).

- Kind: component, hook, utility, block, chart, diagram, pattern
- Use case: search, filtering, scheduling, onboarding, checkout, dashboards, monitoring, agents, chat, editing, uploads, auth, settings, notifications, planning, statistics, finance, marketing, review, devtools, hierarchy, workflows, people, geo, comparison, version-control, legal, help, destructive-actions
- Capability: keyboard, touch, virtualised, streaming, async, drag-and-drop, formatting, animated, accessible, server-mode, real-time, composable
- Status: new, experimental

## Core: Foundation

Import from: @lyndon/ui.

- [hooks](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/hooks.tsx): Shared hooks: controlled-or-uncontrolled state, outside clicks, disclosure, element size, media queries, pointer drags, long press, hotkeys, focus trap, roving focus, streamed text and scroll edges. (hook, ~6.2k tokens; tags: keyboard, touch, composable)
- [icon](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/icon.tsx): Every icon (inline SVG paths) and <Icon>. (component, ~3.0k tokens; tags: theming)
- [part-button](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/part-button.tsx): A part's trigger: a `<button type="button">` with `after` rendered behind the children, or with `asChild` your element (where `disabled` becomes aria-disabled, since a link or div has no disabled state). (component, ~1.3k tokens)
- [slot](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/slot.tsx): Renders its single child element instead of an element of its own, with its props merged in: the engine behind every `asChild` (`<Button asChild><Link href="/pricing">Pricing</Link></Button>`). (component, ~1.2k tokens; tags: composable, navigation)
- [theme-preview](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/theme-preview.tsx): Theme thumbnail split diagonally: the light palette on the left, the chosen dark palette on the right. (component, ~1.6k tokens; tags: comparison)
- [ui-hosts](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/ui-hosts.tsx): Renders the registered hosts (UIProvider includes it). (component, ~579 tokens; tags: composable)
- [ui-provider](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/ui-provider.tsx): Wrap your app once: injects the theme tokens (CSS variables), applies and saves the theme (light, dark, system, seven palettes), provides the number and date formatting locale, hosts page-level UI such as the toast region and turns motion off for reduced-motion users. (component, ~11.5k tokens; tags: theming, accessible)
- [utils](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/utils.tsx): Pure helpers: cn() and variants() for class names, spring() for motion, safeUrl/safeColor for model output, number and date formatting, clamp, mix and contrast. (utility, ~3.4k tokens; tags: devtools)

## Core: Actions

Import from: @lyndon/ui.

- [async-button](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/async-button.tsx): Runs an async action: the button's width tweens down to a spinner square, then out to a green “Saved” with a drawn check, then back. (component, ~3.9k tokens; tags: async, animated, feedback)
- [button](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/button.tsx): Every button presses down slightly (scale .96, CSS). (component, ~3.6k tokens; tags: touch, theming)
- [context-menu](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/context-menu.tsx): Right-click, long-press (touch) or press the Menu key / Shift+F10 on the focused area to open a menu at that point. (component, ~10.9k tokens; tags: keyboard, hierarchy, touch, composable)
- [copy-button](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/copy-button.tsx): Copies `text`. (component, ~4.3k tokens; tags: people, animated, motion)
- [dropdown-menu](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/dropdown-menu.tsx): <DropdownMenu trigger="Options"><MenuItem shortcut="E">Edit</MenuItem>…</DropdownMenu> Opens with click, Enter or ↓; the first item takes focus and the rest stagger in. (component, ~13.4k tokens; tags: keyboard, overlays)
- [hold-to-confirm](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/hold-to-confirm.tsx): Press and hold (pointer, touch, Space or Enter) to confirm a destructive action. (component, ~4.3k tokens; tags: destructive-actions, touch, accessible)
- [like-button](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/like-button.tsx): Heart that bursts on like, with a rolling count. (component, ~4.3k tokens; tags: people, animated, motion)

## Core: Inputs

Import from: @lyndon/ui.

- [calendar](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/calendar.tsx): Month grid (an ARIA grid; day cells grow to 40×40 on touch). (component, ~9.5k tokens; tags: scheduling, accessible)
- [checkbox](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/checkbox.tsx): Checkbox with a drawn checkmark; `children` is its label. (component, ~3.4k tokens; tags: keyboard, forms)
- [chip](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/chip.tsx): Pill button for filters, toggles and suggestions. (component, ~1.2k tokens; tags: filtering)
- [color-picker](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/color-picker.tsx): Swatches, a hue slider and a hex field. (component, ~13.4k tokens; tags: touch, theming)
- [combobox](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/combobox.tsx): Type to filter (the match is bolded), arrows to move, Enter to choose. (component, ~19.1k tokens; tags: search, keyboard, async, forms)
- [currency-input](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/currency-input.tsx): Amount field: thousands separators appear while you type, using the currency's locale (1’234.50 CHF, 1.234,50 EUR…), at most two decimals. (component, ~4.0k tokens; tags: checkout, finance, formatting)
- [date-field](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/date-field.tsx): Typed date entry: day, month and year segments in the locale's order, separators and digits (en-GB dd/mm/yyyy, en-US mm/dd/yyyy, de-DE tt.mm.jjjj, ja-JP yyyy/mm/dd). (component, ~9.6k tokens; tags: scheduling, keyboard, formatting)
- [date-picker](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/date-picker.tsx): Date field: the calendar pops from the field (keyboard ready), the picked day pops, Today and Clear sit under the grid. (component, ~19.9k tokens; tags: scheduling, keyboard, forms)
- [date-range-picker](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/date-range-picker.tsx): Range picker with presets (the matching preset stays highlighted; presets that fall outside `min`/`max` or start or end on an unavailable day are disabled). (component, ~20.8k tokens; tags: scheduling, filtering, dashboards)
- [date-time-field](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/date-time-field.tsx): Typed date and time in one field: the locale's date segments, then hour, minute (second) and am/pm, then the time zone's short name. (component, ~11.7k tokens; tags: scheduling, keyboard)
- [date-time-picker](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/date-time-picker.tsx): Date and time picker: a DateTimeField with a calendar button (or Alt+↓) opening the Calendar with a TimeField under it, and with `timeZonePicker` a searchable time-zone picker beside it. (component, ~36.5k tokens; tags: scheduling, formatting)
- [file-upload](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/file-upload.tsx): Drop zone + file list. (component, ~9.1k tokens; tags: uploads, drag-and-drop)
- [form](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/form.tsx): A <form> that validates its fields and shows the messages in its FormFields, with no form library. (component, ~4.3k tokens; tags: async, accessible, server-mode, forms)
- [inline-date-picker](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/inline-date-picker.tsx): Inline date picker card with two modes: one date, or a range. (component, ~24.0k tokens; tags: scheduling, keyboard)
- [inline-edit](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/inline-edit.tsx): Click (or Enter) to edit; Enter or blur saves, Escape cancels. (component, ~1.8k tokens; tags: editing, keyboard)
- [input](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/input.tsx): Text input. (component, ~1.5k tokens; tags: accessible, forms)
- [magnet-bubble](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/magnet-bubble.tsx): The label bubble above a thumb (the shared tooltip look). (component, ~352 tokens; tags: touch, settings, animated)
- [magnet-marks](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/magnet-marks.tsx): The track decorations: a tick for each point (and each zone centre), a tinted band for each zone. (component, ~1.1k tokens; tags: touch, settings, animated)
- [month-picker](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/month-picker.tsx): Month and year picker: a field that opens a grid of months (its title opens a grid of years), in the locale. (component, ~12.3k tokens; tags: scheduling, checkout)
- [multi-select](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/multi-select.tsx): Pick several: ticks draw in the list, chosen items become chips (with their colour dot) in the field. (component, ~20.3k tokens; tags: filtering, keyboard, search, async, forms)
- [number-stepper](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/number-stepper.tsx): − value + with a rolling number. (component, ~4.6k tokens; tags: checkout, keyboard)
- [otp-input](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/otp-input.tsx): One-time code: auto-advance, paste fills every box, typing into a filled box replaces and re-pops it. (component, ~3.6k tokens; tags: auth, keyboard)
- [password-input](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/password-input.tsx): Password with show/hide (the eye pops when it flips). (component, ~5.2k tokens; tags: auth, accessible)
- [phone-input](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/phone-input.tsx): Phone number with a country picker (flags and dial codes). (component, ~16.6k tokens; tags: formatting, forms)
- [radio-group](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/radio-group.tsx): Radio group with arrow-key navigation. (component, ~3.7k tokens; tags: keyboard, forms)
- [rating](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/rating.tsx): 1–5 stars: every lit star pops again in sequence on each pick. (component, ~5.0k tokens; tags: review, keyboard)
- [segmented-control](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/segmented-control.tsx): Segmented control with a sliding pill: a single choice, so it is a radiogroup (role=radio + aria-checked). (component, ~4.5k tokens; tags: filtering, keyboard, animated)
- [select](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/select.tsx): Custom select: arrows, Enter/Space, type-ahead that cycles through options starting with the typed letter (works closed too), springs open, flips upward near the bottom of the viewport, checkmark on the current option. (component, ~15.3k tokens; tags: keyboard, forms)
- [slider](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/slider.tsx): Range slider with live value. (component, ~15.0k tokens; tags: touch, settings, keyboard, animated, filtering, checkout)
- [switch](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/switch.tsx): Toggle. (component, ~2.9k tokens; tags: settings, animated)
- [tag-input](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/tag-input.tsx): Type and press Enter (or comma) to add; Backspace on empty removes the last tag. (component, ~3.0k tokens; tags: filtering, keyboard, forms)
- [textarea](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/textarea.tsx): Auto-growing textarea; the height animates as lines are added or removed. (component, ~2.4k tokens; tags: editing, forms)
- [time-field](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/time-field.tsx): Typed time entry: hour and minute (and second) segments, with an am/pm segment on a 12-hour clock (from the locale or `hourCycle`); type "930" or "9" then ":" and "30", ↑/↓ step a segment, "a"/"p" sets am/pm, pasting "14:30" or "2:30 PM" fills it. (component, ~14.7k tokens; tags: scheduling, keyboard, formatting)
- [time-picker](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/time-picker.tsx): Time picker: a TimeField (type the time, or step it with ↑/↓) plus a clock button listing times every `step` minutes (15) between `from` and `to` (07:00 to 21:00), opening scrolled to the current one (`value`, `defaultValue` "09:00", `onChange`, `step`, `from`, `to`); it also takes TimeField's `hourCycle`, `locale`, `granularity`, `min`, `max` and `timeZone`. (component, ~14.6k tokens; tags: scheduling, keyboard)
- [time-zone-picker](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/time-zone-picker.tsx): Searchable time-zone picker: a Combobox of `Intl.supportedValuesOf('timeZone')` (about 420 zones, virtualised), labelled with their current offset, "(GMT+01:00) Europe/Zurich", and sorted by it; type a city or "GMT+05". (component, ~19.8k tokens; tags: scheduling, formatting)
- [year-picker](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/year-picker.tsx): Year picker: a field that opens a grid of twelve years (arrows page past the edges). (component, ~11.2k tokens; tags: scheduling, checkout)

## Core: Navigation

Import from: @lyndon/ui.

- [breadcrumbs](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/breadcrumbs.tsx): Trail of links to the current page (the last item, marked aria-current). (component, ~1.3k tokens; tags: hierarchy, accessible)
- [collapsible-sidebar](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/collapsible-sidebar.tsx): App frame whose sidebar folds to icons. (component, ~11.5k tokens; tags: keyboard, layout)
- [mega-menu](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/mega-menu.tsx): Site header whose menus share one panel. (component, ~5.0k tokens; tags: marketing, keyboard)
- [mobile-tab-bar](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/mobile-tab-bar.tsx): Bottom tab bar for phone layouts (grows by the bottom safe area on notched phones): an accent line slides to the active tab, its icon bounces, count badges pop out when cleared, and an optional raised centre button (`onAction`) sits in the middle. (component, ~2.2k tokens; tags: touch, animated)
- [nav-list](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/nav-list.tsx): Vertical nav (sidebars, settings sections). (component, ~1.6k tokens; tags: keyboard, layout)
- [pagination](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/pagination.tsx): Page numbers with ellipses: 1 … 4 5 6 … 20. (component, ~2.8k tokens; tags: hierarchy, accessible)
- [steps](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/steps.tsx): Wizard progress: done steps fill, connecting lines draw across. (component, ~2.0k tokens; tags: onboarding, forms)
- [tabs](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/tabs.tsx): Underline travels to the clicked tab; panel fades in. (component, ~6.7k tokens; tags: keyboard, animated, touch, composable)
- [toggle](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/toggle.tsx): A two-state button (aria-pressed): bold, mute, pin. (component, ~2.4k tokens; tags: editing, keyboard, actions)
- [toggle-group](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/toggle-group.tsx): Toggle buttons sharing one value (single, a radio group) or a set (multiple). (component, ~4.1k tokens; tags: editing, keyboard, actions)
- [toolbar](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/toolbar.tsx): Toolbar and its parts. (component, ~6.6k tokens; tags: editing, keyboard, actions)
- [wizard](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/wizard.tsx): Steps plus the current step's description and Back / Continue buttons. (component, ~4.8k tokens; tags: onboarding, forms)

## Core: Overlays

Import from: @lyndon/ui.

- [alert-dialog](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/alert-dialog.tsx): Confirmation for a consequential action (role="alertdialog"). (component, ~8.7k tokens; tags: destructive-actions, async)
- [command-palette](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/command-palette.tsx): ⌘K palette: type to filter (every word must match the label, keywords or hint), arrows to move, Enter to run. (component, ~14.4k tokens; tags: search, keyboard, async, virtualised)
- [dialog](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/dialog.tsx): Modal dialog. (component, ~8.5k tokens; tags: accessible, destructive-actions, composable)
- [hover-card](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/hover-card.tsx): Rich preview on hover or focus (profiles, links, citations). (component, ~5.8k tokens; tags: people, touch)
- [notification-bell](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/notification-bell.tsx): Bell with an unread count; shakes when new unread items arrive. (component, ~9.7k tokens; tags: notifications, collaboration)
- [popover](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/popover.tsx): Anchored panel: `<Popover><PopoverTrigger>Share</PopoverTrigger><PopoverContent>…</PopoverContent></Popover>`, or the parts `Popover.Root` / `Popover.Trigger` (asChild) / `Popover.Content` (side, align, sideOffset, arrow) / `Popover.Close`. (component, ~7.2k tokens; tags: keyboard, collaboration)
- [sheet](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/sheet.tsx): Panel that slides in from an edge: `side` is `end`, `start`, the physical `left`/`right`, or `bottom`. (component, ~9.0k tokens; tags: filtering, touch)
- [tooltip](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/tooltip.tsx): Short delay, quick fade. (component, ~6.1k tokens; tags: help, touch, accessible)
- [tour](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/tour.tsx): Guided tour over a region. (component, ~4.2k tokens; tags: onboarding, help)

- [offline-indicator](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/offline-indicator.tsx): Connection bar for the top of a view. (component, ~4.3k tokens; tags: monitoring, async)
- [progress](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/progress.tsx): Linear progress bar; the fill springs to each new value. (component, ~1.7k tokens; tags: uploads, animated, marketing, checkout)
- [skeleton](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/skeleton.tsx): Loading placeholder with a shimmer sweep (paused while off screen; off for reduced motion). (component, ~313 tokens; tags: async, animated)
- [spinner](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/spinner.tsx): Spinning ring (role=status, `label` default "Loading"). (component, ~440 tokens; tags: monitoring, accessible)
- [status-icon](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/status-icon.tsx): Round step/status marker for steppers, checks and task lists: done (filled tick, pops in), failed (filled ✕), active (spinning ring, or the step `number` in a bold ring), pending (grey ring, with `number` if given). (component, ~1.6k tokens; tags: monitoring, accessible)
- [toast](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/toast.tsx): Hosts its own toasts for the tree inside it. (component, ~9.2k tokens; tags: notifications, destructive-actions, async, animated)
- [typing-dots](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/typing-dots.tsx): Three bouncing dots: someone (the assistant, a teammate) is typing. (component, ~327 tokens; tags: chat, animated)

## Core: Data display

Import from: @lyndon/ui.

- [accordion](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/accordion.tsx): Accordion: panels grow to their content height and the chevron rotates. (component, ~4.7k tokens; tags: help, animated, keyboard, composable)
- [animated-list](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/animated-list.tsx): Any list whose items animate in, out and into new positions. (component, ~339 tokens; tags: notifications, animated)
- [avatar](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/avatar.tsx): Avatar from @lyndon/ui. (component, ~2.8k tokens; tags: people, collaboration)
- [data-table](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/data-table.tsx): Sortable table; rows slide to their new position when the order changes. (component, ~2.2k tokens; tags: dashboards, keyboard, accessible)
- [json-viewer](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/json-viewer.tsx): JSON tree with typed colours (strings, numbers, booleans, null). (component, ~13.6k tokens; tags: devtools, keyboard)
- [kbd](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/kbd.tsx): A key or shortcut ("⌘K", "Esc"). (component, ~188 tokens; tags: help, keyboard)
- [shortcut-sheet](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/shortcut-sheet.tsx): Keyboard shortcuts in titled groups (General / Navigation / Editing…). (component, ~9.3k tokens; tags: help, keyboard)
- [stat](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/stat.tsx): KPI tile: label, a ▲ / ▼ delta pill tinted by whether the change is good, a rolling value and an area sparkline along the bottom. (component, ~3.9k tokens; tags: dashboards, animated)
- [task-list](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/task-list.tsx): To-do list built on AnimatedList: type and press Enter (or Add) to add, an empty submit shakes the input, ticking an item draws the check and strikes the text through, ✕ slides it out while the rest close up. (component, ~5.6k tokens; tags: planning, animated)
- [timeline](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/timeline.tsx): Activity feed grouped by day. (component, ~2.1k tokens; tags: monitoring, collaboration)
- [virtual-list](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/virtual-list.tsx): A scrolling list that renders only the items in view. (component, ~7.0k tokens; tags: virtualised)

## Core: Layout

Import from: @lyndon/ui.

- [card](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/card.tsx): Surface for grouping content. (component, ~326 tokens; tags: dashboards)

- [conversation](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/conversation.tsx): The scrolling message log. (component, ~8.6k tokens; tags: chat, agents, streaming, async)
- [ghost-text-input](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/ghost-text-input.tsx): Inline completion: the rest of the best-matching suggestion shows in grey after what you typed; Tab accepts it (with a small bump). (component, ~1.5k tokens; tags: editing, keyboard, inputs)
- [message](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/message.tsx): One message. (component, ~27.7k tokens; tags: chat, agents, streaming, async)
- [message-actions](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/message-actions.tsx): The row under an answer: "Stopped" when it was cut short, Copy (`text`, read when clicked), thumbs up / down (controlled `rating` + `onRate`, or uncontrolled), Regenerate or Retry (`onRetry`), and anything you add (`children`, e.g. (component, ~5.3k tokens; tags: chat, agents, streaming, async)
- [message-parts](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/message-parts.tsx): Renders a message's parts in order: text as Markdown (or through `renderers.text`; links through safeUrl, `[n]` is a Citation of the message's n-th source), reasoning as Reasoning, tool calls as ToolCard (approvals go to `onDecideTool`; data through `renderers.value`), files as attachment tiles, errors with a Retry (`onRetry`), and `data` parts through `renderData` (nothing by default). (component, ~27.1k tokens; tags: chat, agents, streaming, async)
- [model-comparison](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/model-comparison.tsx): Same prompt, several models streamed side by side at their own speeds: thinking dots, first-token time, tokens/s and cost. (component, ~12.5k tokens; tags: comparison, data)
- [permission-request](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/permission-request.tsx): Ask before acting: say what, to whom, and why. (component, ~13.7k tokens; tags: agents, review)
- [prompt-input](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/prompt-input.tsx): The prompt box for chats. (component, ~10.6k tokens; tags: chat, agents, streaming, async, uploads, drag-and-drop, inputs)
- [reasoning](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/reasoning.tsx): Collapsible model reasoning in the ThinkingSteps style. (component, ~3.6k tokens; tags: agents, streaming, animated)
- [shimmer-text](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/shimmer-text.tsx): Text with a light sweeping across it. (component, ~446 tokens; tags: animated)
- [source-list](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/source-list.tsx): Source chips under an answer: tile, title and domain, numbered, each a link when it has a `url`. (component, ~2.6k tokens; tags: review, chat, search)
- [sources-panel](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/sources-panel.tsx): Answer with numbered citations next to their source cards (stacked below on phones). (component, ~3.9k tokens; tags: search, review)
- [streaming-text](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/streaming-text.tsx): Reveals `text` word by word (useStreamedText as a component). (component, ~1.1k tokens; tags: streaming, animated)
- [suggested-edit](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/suggested-edit.tsx): Proposed rewrite. (component, ~5.4k tokens; tags: editing, review, keyboard)
- [suggestions](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/suggestions.tsx): Suggestion chips (starters, follow-ups). (component, ~1.3k tokens; tags: chat, agents, streaming, async)
- [thinking-steps](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/thinking-steps.tsx): Reasoning as a vertical stepper. (component, ~6.9k tokens; tags: agents, streaming, animated)
- [tool-call](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/tool-call.tsx): Collapsible tool-call row: shimmering label and spinner while running, a check and the past tense when done. (component, ~2.4k tokens; tags: agents)
- [tool-card](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/tool-card.tsx): A tool call from a message: status icon, tool name and state, and (click to open) its arguments and result, as data (indented JSON, or `renderValue`, e.g. (component, ~7.4k tokens; tags: agents)
- [voice-input](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/voice-input.tsx): Mic button with a live waveform. (component, ~4.7k tokens; tags: chat, animated, inputs)

## Extras: agents

Import from: @lyndon/ui/agentrun, @lyndon/ui/aiagent.

- [agent-run](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/agent-run.tsx): One model of an agent run (spans, events, tokens, cost) with a streaming reducer and useAgentRun, plus adapters from OpenTelemetry GenAI traces (OTLP/JSON), Vercel AI SDK results and UI streams, and LangGraph astream_events. (hook, ~18.2k tokens; tags: agents, monitoring, streaming, real-time, new)
- [agent-transit-map](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/agent-transit-map.tsx): Live multi-agent "transit map", driven by the same WorkflowEngine as StateMachine. (diagram, ~45.2k tokens; tags: agents, workflows, real-time, experimental, ai)
- [ai-canvas](https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/ai-canvas.tsx): Chat on the left, a living document on the right. (component, ~20.1k tokens; tags: editing, experimental, code)

(component, ~47.7k tokens; tags: settings)
